context.content: So me myself live 10 minutes by car to the nearest Pokestop. That's not TOO bad because there are a couple of pokestops in that area. But I have to drive there which is kinda annoying. So I came up with this idea. I do live pretty much "in the forest" and one could blame me for living isolated from the city. But that's just how it is. The reason Pokestops work in cities are that there are enough real landmarks in cities that can be used. But where I live, it's mainly forest, stones and rivers. Hard to find anything "landmarky". So I thought, to get it playable for most people while not making too much of a workload to the developers, non-densely populated areas could have randomly generated pokestops that disappear once they are swiped. New ones will appear regularly after one of the existing ones are swiped. This would surely make it a lot easier for people on the countryside to enjoy the game, and if these random generated Pokestops could have some kind of special item only obtainly from there, that would make people come and explore the countryside more :) I think this idea would work pretty well.
